title: Enrollment Guidelines for the Prepaid Dental HMO Plans: Markets, Service Area and Membership Terms
content:
**Section 1. Markets in which each plan is offered.** Each Cascade DentalCare DHMO plan of the Prepaid Dental HMO Plans is offered only in the markets its entry gate admits, and every plan requires residence in the service area. The two highest plans are offered to employer groups only, subject to a minimum number of enrolled lives in the group.

| Plan | Markets admitted | Service area residence required | Minimum enrolled lives in the group |
|---|---|---|---|
| Cascade DentalCare DHMO 215 | Individual and group | Yes | None stated |
| Cascade DentalCare DHMO 315 | Individual and group | Yes | None stated |
| Cascade DentalCare DHMO 415 | Individual and group | Yes | None stated |
| Cascade DentalCare DHMO 515 | Individual and group | Yes | None stated |
| Cascade DentalCare DHMO 615 | Group only | Yes | 5 |
| Cascade DentalCare DHMO 715 | Group only | Yes | 25 |

**Section 2. Membership terms.**

(a) *Service area states* — the list of states where DHMO coverage is offered; the subscriber must reside there.
(b) *Out-of-area disenrollment* — "end of month after notice": coverage ends on the last day of the month after the move is reported.
(c) *Re-enrollment lockout* — calendar months after a voluntary termination during which the person may not re-enroll in an individual DHMO.
(d) *Dependent child age limit* — age in years; a child's enrollment ends at the end of the month of this birthday.

| Plan | Service area states | Out-of-area disenrollment | Re-enrollment lockout (calendar months) | Dependent child age limit (years) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cascade DentalCare DHMO 215 | WA, OR, CA, AZ, NV | End of month after notice | 12 | 26 |
| Cascade DentalCare DHMO 315 | WA, OR, CA, AZ, NV | End of month after notice | 12 | 26 |
| Cascade DentalCare DHMO 415 | WA, OR, CA, AZ, NV | End of month after notice | 12 | 26 |
| Cascade DentalCare DHMO 515 | WA, OR, CA, AZ, NV | End of month after notice | 12 | 26 |
| Cascade DentalCare DHMO 615 | WA, OR, CA, AZ, NV | End of month after notice | 12 | 26 |
| Cascade DentalCare DHMO 715 | WA, OR, CA, AZ, NV | End of month after notice | 12 | 26 |

**Section 3. Applying the terms (hypothetical cases).**

- A group of 12 enrolled lives may be offered the DHMO 615 (minimum 5) but not the DHMO 715 (minimum 25); a group of exactly 25 enrolled lives meets the DHMO 715 minimum; an individual applicant may be offered only the DHMO 215, 315, 415 or 515.
- A subscriber who reports on 9 June a move out of Washington, Oregon, California, Arizona and Nevada has coverage ending on 31 July, the last day of the month after the month in which the move was reported.
- A dependent child whose 26th birthday falls on 14 August has an enrollment ending on 31 August, the end of the month of that birthday.
- The service area is the same five states — Washington, Oregon, California, Arizona and Nevada — under every plan.
